== Overview ==

The Koshei the Deathless quest had a hidden flaw. After collecting the four amulet pieces and bringing them to A Sweaty Cyclops &mdash; paying his gold, waiting the long hours for his hammer to finish &mdash; the reassembled amulet worked in your hand, but Koshei himself would not recognise it. The final step was impossible, for every player. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
